svg.title: Leg press, side view
svg.desc: Side view of a figure seated and reclined in a generic leg press machine with the back and hips on the pads and both feet flat on the foot plate, hands on the side grips. The plate travels back toward the body until the knees are bent about 90 degrees with the hips still on the seat, then the legs press it away again to nearly straight, without locking out.
